uart.signal: crates/firmware-nucleo-h723zg-smoke boots on configs/systems/nucleo-h723zg.yaml, enables GPIOB/GPIOD and USART3 in RCC, sets PD8/PD9 to AF7 and writes the banner to USART3 (the ST-LINK VCP); uart_contains matches it, and gpio_edges requires LD1 on PB0 to toggle at least 4 times.
uart.lane: core-onboarding-smoke (push to main + nightly cron): matrix id nucleo-h723zg (scripts/onboarding_smoke.sh)

spi.signal: stock stm32duino SPI.transfer on SPI1 (PA5/PA6/PB5) reads the MAX31855 device's own 32-bit frame (exact default frame 0x01901600 required for LW_L4_OK).

i2c.signal: stock stm32duino Wire on I2C1 (PB8/PB9) writes and reads back the INA219 model at 0x40: config 0x399F and bus-voltage register 0x19CA must match exactly for LW_L3_OK.
